title.narrative: Ministry of Education has a new evidence based proposal for its life skills programme to prevent violence in educational communities(67208), Text

baseline.value: Current life skills initiative in schools nationwide not institutionalized

target.value: 2022:Piloting and systematization (including costing) of the implementation of the new life skills education programme in prioritized territories

actual.value: 2022:A methodology for the development of transferable skills is currently being developed and piloted in the city of Manta, with the participation of 350 adolescents, 25 Student Counselors, and an innovative proposal for the development of materials.
